title: Australian Grilled Chicken Sandwich
description: A classic outdoor grilled chicken sandwich with a twist of Australian flavors. Serve immediately for a delicious and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Australian bush tomato sauce
ingredients.notes: Available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and your favorite herbs.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast sandwich bread on the grill.
Assemble sandwiches by spreading mayonnaise on the bottom slice of bread, then topping with a chicken breast, a spoonful of bush tomato sauce, lettuce, tomato, red onion, and cheese (if using).
Top with the top slice of bread.
